blocker_detail: Public venue read probes succeeded, but Level 5 requires >=2 consecutive BTC 5-minute rollovers (~10+ minutes) of mutation-disabled continuous SHADOW on an operator host. The continuous SHADOW workflow is implemented (config + CLI routing); the long-lived live market-data session itself was not executed in the agent run. Live admission remains disabled; tiny_live_admitted remains false.
